title: Tommy Egan Runs Into Liliana One Of His Old Carriers From Season One Of Power In Chicago In Episode 2 Of Power IV: Force
htmlContent:
After leaving New York City, Tommy Egan is now in Chicago when he runs into one of his former drug  "runner" girls. If you are not familiar with her story, she was cut across the face by the Pink Sneaker girl hitter, who Kanan Stark hired. Ghost and Tommy argued whether to kill her or not.

Tommy wanted her dead, and Ghost was about to kill her, but Julio talked to Ghost and said something about how it would look if you murdered a loyal worker who was doing her job. So Ghost, without Tommy's knowledge, is promoting her to be a launcher/money machine.

Tommy, who still believes she was murdered by Ghost, later discovers that Julio was promoted, and he was the last to hear about it. In episode two of Power Force, Liliana turns up in an alley behind Tommy and says, "Who the f*** told you I was here," after pistol-whipping him to the ground.

After a fight that ends with Egan being cut and hitting her, Tommy replies, 'Wait a minute, I know you."

Liliana: Of course you do, pendejo. You are here to kill me."

Tommy: That f*** scar, Liliana, I should have killed you back in New York.

Liliana: You dumb enough to do this in front of an audience?

Tommy: Hmm

Liliana: I got the drop on you once I'll do it again.

Tommy: Not a F*****chance.

Tommy: That's why you can't have nice things.

Power creator Courtney Kemp has shared that if a character has not been killed, they can possibly make a return later down the road.

Make sure you catch Power Book IV: Force on Starz at 8 PM EST on Sunday nights.
